model.notes: Pinned 27B BF16 multimodal backbone plus joint schema head; native text/images, no audio. Complete float32-softmax probabilities, strict full-input context rejection, no persistent cache or CUDA graphs.

limitations: Offline declaration checks only; no models loaded or endpoints contacted.
Context length, hardware and media decoding remain runtime checks.
Costs are operator estimates, not measured or provider-verified charges.
The request contract allows at most 52 options and 64 questions per request.

timing: monotonic seconds since run start; latency measured from scheduled arrival
seed_policy: recorded_only; no stochastic sampling or support selection in E1
